feedback_loop.mechanism: After each WhatsApp conversation, categorize the top 3 questions asked by the traveler
feedback_loop.integration: Feed top question into next week's new page topic auto-generation
feedback_loop.example: If 15 travelers ask 'kid-friendly snorkeling' → next week's page covers 'snorkeling with children in Zanzibar'. If 10 travelers ask 'vegetarian food options' → next week's page covers 'vegetarian dining in Zanzibar'
feedback_loop.flywheel: more pages → more search visibility → more WhatsApp conversations → more insight → more pages

content_expansion_schedule.weekly_topic: 1 new problem-solution page per week using ZANZIABR CSV research data
research_sources: content_ideas_for_zanzibar.csv (NYT '36 Hours in Zanzibar', 2271 est. visits, 17 backlinks)
competitor analysis for content gaps: safety, packing, timing, family, romance, self-drive, cultural
content_expansion_schedule.auto_generation_template: cp existing-template.njk new-page-name.njk + edit with problem-specific content + add WhatsApp CTA with intent data + git commit + Netlify auto-deploy
